ui.notices.title: Notice board
ui.notices.lead: Anyone may read what is pinned here, and nobody signs it. A notice stays up for {days}.
ui.notices.too_many: You have as many notices up as one may. Take one of yours down to pin another.
ui.notices.wait: You can pin another notice in {time}.
ui.notices.full: The board is full: a new notice takes the oldest one down.
ui.notices.too_short: Write a little more: a notice holds {min} to {max} letters.
ui.notices.hint: Write your notice, then pin it (Ctrl+Enter). Esc leaves.
